messages:
kai: Quick RFC follow-up — propose adding an index-only header to safetensors-like bundles so loaders can mmap the index and do zero-copy routing. Thoughts?

mohit: yes please. main concern: version skew and backward compat. keep it explicit.

lina: Agree. Also need a fallback for HTTP-only stores: range requests + small header fetch.

kai: Exactly. Draft header proto:
```
magic: 'RSWB' // redwood weights bundle
version: 2
index_offset: 4096
index_len: 8192
manifest_hash: sha256:...
flags: zero_copy | partial_ranges
```

mohit: +1 but add `compatible_min_version` field to handle older runtimes.

ada: How will this work with sharded artifacts? index should list shard ids + byte ranges.

kai: plan: top-level bundle can be either monolithic or shard-manifest. Index entries: {name, dtype, shape, shard_id, file_offset, length, qscheme}

lina: We should expose an API: `Loader.open(path, mode='mmap'|'stream', prefer_zero_copy=True)`, and `Loader.prefetch(keys)` for warm paths.

mohit: Also need eviction hooks for KV cache interplay — warmup that touches first-8 tokens is good heuristic.

ci-bot: build 7321 passed: model-format-schema-tests

ada: Tests: unit for header parsing, integr tests with range-server, perf microbench for mmap vs range+cache.

kai: tradeoffs: mmap is fastest but needs filesystem or special blobstore support. HTTP range has latency spikes for many small requests -> plan: range aggregator + per-connection pipelining.

lina: Ops: provide a `bundle-compat-check` CLI to validate bundles pre-upload.

mohit: Don't forget on-disk encryption + KMS — header must be cleartext or separate metadata file.

kai: proposal TL;DR: index-only header v2, fallback to range aggregator, loader API with mode flags, test matrix. I'll push a short RFC doc after this thread. If no objections by EOD, we'll lock interface.

ada: fine by me :thumbsup:

lina: +1

mohit: +1
